content.title: About
content.content: Hard salted pretzel sticks coated with dark chocolate. They feature a crunchy texture, a slightly sweet chocolate shell and the classic salty pretzel flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Hard pretzels originate from Germany, where they are known as "Brezeln".
Chocolate coating extends shelf life by protecting the dry pretzel from moisture.
The salty‑sweet contrast is one of the most popular flavor pairings in snack foods.
Pretzels are commonly served at sporting events and movie theaters as a quick bite.
During the 2020s there has been a noticeable rise in demand for chocolate‑covered versions of traditional pretzels.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: The wheat‑based hard pretzel provides slow‑release energy from complex carbohydrates.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Dark chocolate is rich in flavonoids, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: Provides iron
items.content: Both wheat flour and cocoa powder contribute modest amounts of iron, supporting blood formation.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Chocolate stimulates serotonin and endorphin production, improving mood.

items.title: Magnesium content
items.content: Magnesium in chocolate aids normal muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The wheat‑based pretzel can trigger reactions in people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: The chocolate coating adds sugar, so the snack should be consumed in moderation, especially by individuals with diabetes.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Both the hard pretzel and chocolate make the product energy‑dense; large portions may contribute to weight gain.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Dark chocolate contains small amounts of caffeine, which may affect caffeine‑sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pretzels are convenient as a stand‑alone snack, paired with coffee, tea or milk. They can be added to dessert platters, used as a garnish for ice cream, or incorporated into recipes that call for a crunchy sweet‑salty element.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For longer storage, keep refrigerated to prevent the chocolate from melting and losing its crunch. Discard if the pretzels become soft, develop off‑odors, or show any mold.
